title.en: Limited Liability Partnerships (Register of Controllers) Regulations 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 20 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 7 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Limited Liability Partnerships (Register of Controllers) Regulations 2022 and come into operation on 4 October 2022 at 12.01 a.m.

2. In these Regulations —
“identity card” has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the National Registration Act 1965;
“registered corporate service provider” has the meaning given by section 2(1) of the Corporate Service Providers Act 2024.
[S 301/2025 wef 09/06/2025]

heading.en: Prescribed manner of confirmation under section 47(7) of Act

text.en:
6.—(1) For the purposes of section 47(7) of the Act, the particulars of a controller to be entered in a limited liability partnership’s register of controllers are treated as confirmed if —
(a)in response to a notice of the limited liability partnership given under section 48(2) of the Act, a person confirms, or a registered corporate service provider confirms on behalf of the person, that the person is a registrable controller and has provided those particulars; or
[S 301/2025 wef 09/06/2025]
(b)a person has notified the limited liability partnership under section 51(1) of the Act that the person is a registrable controller and has provided those particulars.
(2) For the purposes of section 47(7) of the Act, the particulars of a controller to be updated in a limited liability partnership’s register of controllers are treated as confirmed if —
(a)in response to a notice of the limited liability partnership given under section 49(1) or 50A(1) of the Act, the registrable controller confirms, or a registered corporate service provider confirms on behalf of the registrable controller, that a change in the registrable controller’s particulars that are stated in the register of controllers has occurred and has provided those particulars as the particulars that have changed;
[S 301/2025 wef 09/06/2025]
[S 351/2025 wef 16/06/2025]
(b)in response to a notice of the limited liability partnership given under section 50(1) or 50A(1) of the Act, the registrable controller confirms, or a registered corporate service provider confirms on behalf of the registrable controller, that the particulars that are stated in the register of controllers are incorrect and has provided those particulars as the correct particulars; or
[S 301/2025 wef 09/06/2025]
[S 351/2025 wef 16/06/2025]
(c)the registrable controller has notified the limited liability partnership under section 52(1) of the Act that a change in the registrable controller’s particulars that are stated in the register of controllers has occurred and has provided those particulars as the particulars that have changed.
(3) The particulars provided under paragraph (1) or (2) must be accompanied by —
(a)a statement made by the registrable controller that the information provided in his or her confirmation or notification (as the case may be) is true and accurate; and
(b)the registrable controller’s signature, and the date of the signature, affixed immediately below the statement.
[S 351/2025 wef 16/06/2025]

heading.en: Prescribed form and manner of lodgment

text.en: 10. For the purposes of section 54(3) of the Act, any lodgment made under section 54(2)(b) of the Act must be made through the electronic transaction system established under Part 6A of the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority Act 2004.

heading.en: Prescribed circumstances for disclosure, etc., of central register of controllers

text.en:
11.—(1) For the purposes of section 54(6) of the Act, the Registrar may disclose any information in the central register of controllers of limited liability partnerships kept by the Registrar to —
(a)a public agency, where —
(i)the public agency has requested information in the central register of controllers of limited liability partnerships; and
(ii)the information so requested is for the purpose of enabling the public agency to administer or enforce any written law or conduct public procurement; or
(b)a financial institution, for the purpose of enabling the financial institution —
(i)to conduct customer due diligence measures to prevent money laundering and terrorism financing; or
(ii)to otherwise comply with any directions issued under section 16 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2022, or any regulations made under section 192 of that Act, for the prevention of money laundering and terrorism financing.
(2) In this regulation —
“financial institution” has the meaning given by section 2 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2022;
“public agency” has the meaning given by section 53(6) of the Act.
[S 351/2025 wef 16/06/2025]
12. The Limited Liability Partnerships (Register of Controllers) Regulations 2017 (G.N. No. S 120/2017) are revoked.

SECOND SCHEDULE
Regulation 5
First column
Second column
Provision of Act (description)
Prescribed frequency, time or period
1.Section 47(5) and (6)(a) (prescribed time to enter particulars in register and update register)
7 days after each date on which the particulars of any controller are confirmed by the controller
2.Section 47(5) and (6)(b) (prescribed time to enter or update particulars with a note indicating that the particulars have not been confirmed by the controller, if the limited liability partnership does not receive the controller’s confirmation)
7 days after the end of 30 days after the date on which a notice mentioned in section 48(2), 49(1) or 50(1) (as the case may be) of the Act is sent by the limited liability partnership
3.Section 47A(4) (prescribed period within which matters mentioned in section 47A(3) must be entered in register of controllers)
2 business days after the date mentioned in section 47A(4)(a) or (b) of the Act, as the case may be
4.Section 47A(5) (prescribed period within which register of controllers must be updated to reflect change in particulars entered under section 47A(3)(b))
2 business days after the date on which the limited liability partnership knows, or has reasonable grounds to believe, that any change in the particulars entered in its register of controllers under section 47A(3)(b) of the Act has occurred
5.Section 48(3)(a) (prescribed time for compliance with a notice mentioned in section 48(2))
30 days after the date on which the notice mentioned in section 48(2) of the Act is sent by the limited liability partnership
6.Section 48(3)(c) (prescribed period within which a notice mentioned in section 48(2) must be given)
2 business days after the date on which the limited liability partnership first knows the existence of, or first has reasonable grounds to believe that there exists, a person to whom a notice must be given under section 48(2) of the Act
7.Section 49(2) (prescribed period within which a notice mentioned in section 49(1) must be given)
2 business days after the date on which the limited liability partnership first knows of a relevant change in the particulars of a registrable controller that are stated in the limited liability partnership’s register of controllers, or first has reasonable grounds to believe that such a change has occurred
8.Section 48(3)(a) as applied by section 49(3) (prescribed time for compliance with a notice mentioned in section 49(1))
30 days after the date on which the notice mentioned in section 49(1) of the Act is sent by the limited liability partnership
9.Section 50(2) (prescribed period within which a notice mentioned in section 50(1) must be given)
2 business days after the date on which the limited liability partnership first knows or first has reasonable grounds to believe that any of the particulars of a registrable controller that are stated in the limited liability partnership’s register of controllers is incorrect
10.Section 48(3)(a) as applied by section 50(3) (prescribed time for compliance with a notice mentioned in section 50(1))
30 days after the date on which the notice mentioned in section 50(1) of the Act is sent by the limited liability partnership
11.Section 51(2) (prescribed time for compliance with the requirements of section 51(1))
30 days after the date on which the person first knew or ought reasonably to have known that that person was a registrable controller
12.Section 52(2) (prescribed time for compliance with the requirements of section 52(1))
30 days after the date on which the person first knew or ought reasonably to have known that a relevant change has occurred in the prescribed particulars of that person
13.Section 54(3) (prescribed time within which the particulars mentioned in section 54(2)(b)(i) must be lodged with the Registrar)
For a limited liability partnership registered before 16 June 2025 — 2 business days after the date on which the limited liability partnership enters the particulars of its registrable controllers in the register
For a limited liability partnership registered on or after 16 June 2025 — at the time of registration
14.Section 54(3) (prescribed time within which the updates mentioned in section 54(2)(b)(ii) must be lodged with the Registrar)
Where the limited liability partnership enters or updates the particulars of any registrable controller in its register under section 47(6) of the Act — 2 business days after the date on which the limited liability partnership enters or updates the particulars of the registrable controller
15.Section 50A(1) (prescribed frequency at which a notice mentioned in section 50A(1) must be given)
At least one notice mentioned in section 50A(1) of the Act must be given every calendar year to each registrable controller whose particulars are stated in the limited liability partnership’s register of controllers
16.Section 50A(2)(a) (prescribed time for compliance with a notice mentioned in section 50A(1))
30 days after the date on which the notice mentioned in section 50A(1) of the Act is sent by the limited liability partnership
[S 351/2025 wef 16/06/2025]
